visual.name: PowerBIChatbot
visual.description: AI-powered chatbot for Power BI that lets you analyze your data using natural language. Ask questions in any language, get instant insights, charts, and DAX formulas. Supports five AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Azure OpenAI) with bring-your-own-key model. Available in English, Czech, German, Spanish, and French.
